description: Analyzes the bound dataset with pandas: filter (pandas query syntax), column selection, group-by aggregations, sorting and a row limit. Reads the platform's dataset copy, not the live source.

aggregations.description: Column -> aggregate function map used with group_by, e.g. {"price": "mean"}.

filter.description: Optional pandas query expression, e.g. price > 100 and country == 'TR'.
